articles.title: UK parliament to probe Nigel Farage’s $6.8 million donation from crypto billionaire
articles.snippet: If found guilty of violating the Parliamentary code of conduct, the Reform UK party leader could be suspended from the House of Commons.

articles.title: Clarity Act amendments would remake key parts of crypto bill but have doubtful future
articles.snippet: The U.S. crypto market structure bill is being targeted with dozens of amendments aiming to change or add to the text as its Senate hearing approaches.

articles.title: Animoca-backed NUVA connects Figure's $19 billion of tokenized assets to Ethereum
articles.snippet: The protocol, led by veteran BNY executive Anthony Moro, aims to connect real-world assets with DeFi markets, starting with home equity lines of credit and Treasuries.

articles.title: Crypto wallet provider Ledger puts U.S. IPO plans on hold due to market conditions
articles.snippet: The French crypto security firm, which is said to have explored a potential $4 billion U.S. listing, is reassessing its public market plans as volatile conditions weigh on investor appetite for crypto IPOs.
